name: spice-frother-triangle-deepseek-v4.1-flash-s3-r1
caseTitle: ngspice: triangle-wave carrier for a milk frother
prompt: A milk frother's heater is driven by PWM, and the PWM needs a 1 kHz triangle-wave carrier of 2 V peak to peak. Build that oscillator in ngspice using only DC supplies, so the oscillation comes from the circuit itself, and simulate 20 ms. In a .control block, save the carrier voltage with wrdata to a .txt file so it can be plotted.

source.text:
* 1 kHz triangle-wave carrier for PWM, 2 V peak-to-peak
*
* Astable oscillator built from two op-amp stages:
*   1) an inverting integrator (Rint, Cint) that produces the triangle,
*   2) a non-inverting Schmitt trigger (R1, R2) that produces the square
*      wave which drives the integrator.
* The feedback loop itself sustains the oscillation: no PULSE/SIN/AC
* source is used, only the two DC supply rails.

* --- DC supply rails (the only independent sources) ---
Vcc  vcc 0 DC  12
Vee  vee 0 DC -12

* --- Inverting integrator: vc -- Rint -- n1, Cint n1->carrier, Rf DC bias ---
Rint vc   n1     25k
Cint n1   carrier 100n
Rf   n1   carrier 1Meg
* ideal op-amp: gain 1e5, smooth output saturation at +/-10 V
Bint carrier 0 V = 10*(1e5*(0-V(n1)))/(1e-5+abs(1e5*(0-V(n1))))

* --- Non-inverting Schmitt trigger ---
* vp = (vcarrier/R1 + vc/R2)/(1/R1+1/R2)
* thresholds are -/+ (R1/R2)*Vsat = -/+1 V, giving a 2 Vpp triangle
R1  carrier vp 1k
R2  vc      vp 10k
Cvp vp      0  1p
Bcomp vc 0 V = 10*(1e5*V(vp))/(1e-5+abs(1e5*V(vp)))

* start the integrator off-centre so the astable starts oscillating
.ic V(carrier)=1
.tran 1u 20m uic

.control
run
wrdata carrier.txt v(carrier)
.endc
.end
